messages:
alex.m: Heads-up — deploy-bot kicked off a config-only rollout (routing policy + batching window + tenant fast-fail). Requesting ops and oncall eyeballs for the next 30m.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Rollout started: id=1758888888 config={route_policy: v2-narrow, batch_window_ms: 18->12, tenant_fastfail: true} canary=5% links: https://deploy.redwood/roll/1758888888

sam: ack, watching p95 and error rate.

dana: quick q: tenant_fastfail -> does that fast-fail on first 429 or wait for consecutive failures?

ravi: it's configured to fast-fail on first 429 for this flag, cooldown 60s. excerpt:
```
routing.fast_fail: true
routing.fast_fail_consecutive: 1
routing.fast_fail_cooldown_s: 60
```

maggie: @dana @sam I'm on pager for the next 20m, will jump if error rate > 1%.

alex.m: rollout plan: 5% for 10m -> 25% for 20m -> 100%. Abort triggers: p95 > +30% OR errors > 0.8% OR KV cache miss rate +5%. Rollback playbook in thread.

sam: will post metric check commands for quick ops validation.

sam: `kubectl logs -l rollout=1758888888 -n inference | grep fast_fail` (quick smoke)

deploy-bot: Healthcheck t+5m: canary healthy. metrics snapshot: p95=110ms (-1%), errors=0.12%

ravi: looks good. small operational ask: keep the older routing variant pinned and available for 10m after full rollout for instant flip if needed.

alex.m: agreed. post-rollout we'll pin v1 for +10m with a low-weight placeholder so rollback is instant: `redwood route pin --name default --model route:v1-stable --until +10m`

dana: batching window drop 18->12ms might increase CPU cycles. Infra ok with headroom?

maggie: confirmed on infra side — CPU headroom +12% across canary nodes.

sam: if we see a spike I'll run `deploy-bot abort 1758888888` (falls back to v1).

alex.m: I'll own active monitoring and post updates. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reached 25% at t+15m — no abort. logs: https://deploy.redwood/logs/1758888888

maggie: seeing a small p95 bump for tenant T-439, isolating.

ravi: can we exclude T-439 from the rollout quickly? `redwood routing exclude --tenant T-439 --roll 1758888888`

alex.m: done — T-439 excluded, traffic rebalanced.

sam: rollout to 100% complete at t+40m. final metrics stable: p95 baseline ~108ms, errors 0.15%. I'll draft the release notes: "routing: narrow-policy; batching: 12ms; tenant-fastfail enabled; rollback pinned" and open PR.

dana: thanks all. closing the loop unless anyone needs more time.

maggie: leaving monitoring on for 10m post-rollout, will escalate if anything drifts.
